text:
jia: FYI ran into a poor UX in integration tests: /v1/embeddings returned a bare 413 when we sent a mixed-dim batch. Client had no way to tell if this was bytes, dims, or route.

ravi: Ugh. We should stop returning opaque 413s for common preflight failures. Proposal: return structured preflight errors (4xx) with stable error codes for clients to act on.

jia: Repro snippet: ```POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: Content-Type: application/json, X-Client: node-repro
Body: { "inputs": [[...1024 floats...], [...512 floats...]] }
Response: 413 Request Entity Too Large
``` No additional fields.

tim: Two quick options: (A) Add an opt-in lightweight header from clients with a dims/bytes hint so server can cheaply validate and return actionable errors, or (B) server does a fast shape-only scan when batch size exceeds threshold. Prefer (A) first for perf.

marta: From Console/Support POV we want a signal for these: error_code, dims_signature (e.g., "1024:3,512:1"), tenant_hash, and whether SDK auto-split was attempted. Then surface a "Fix with auto-split" action.

jia: Sketch for header: `X-Embed-Shape-Hint: dims=1024,1024,512;bytes=12500;items=3` Server returns 200+warnings or 400 with `error_code` and `suggestion`. If header absent, runtime still tries cheap detection for large batches.

ravi: Important: the structured error needs machine-friendly fields: `error_code`, `machine_msg`, `client_hint`, `can_auto_split`. Keep it flat and stable across SDKs.

jia: Example error body we can return (stringified in the text here): ```{ "error_code": "dims_mismatch", "machine_msg": "batch contains vectors of differing dimensionality", "client_hint": "split by dimensionality or send separate requests", "can_auto_split": "true", "split_plan": "0-1:1024;2-2:512" }``` Note: `split_plan` encoded as a string to avoid nested objects in downstream logs.

tim: SDKs should interpret `can_auto_split` and `split_plan` if present. If `can_auto_split=true` the SDK may retry automatically (configurable) to reduce customer pain. We'll add helper in SDKs to parse `split_plan`.

marta: Console should ingest telemetry for these failures but redact vector contents. Keep only dims_signature and item counts. For tenant-level actions, provide an admin toggle: "Enable auto-split for this tenant" with an audit log entry.

jia: Security: avoid echoing any vector values back. `split_plan` must only reference indices and dims, not vector contents. Telemetry samples (for debugging) should be gated to internal access only.

ops-bot: deploy note: embeds-prod canary 2024-06-15T09:12 applied v2.7.8. Monitor preflight-mismatch metric.

ravi: Implementation plan: 1) RFC + error schema, 2) header acceptance + cheap validation path, 3) server-side detection for big batches, 4) SDK helpers to auto-split, 5) Console telemetry + tenant toggle. Split into two releases: minimal server+error schema first, telemetry+console after.

tim: Runtime perf note: shape check is O(N) but cheap (just vector length checks). For continuous batching, only run it when incoming payloads exceed item_count > 1 or bytes > 8KB to avoid extra checks on small calls.

jia: I'll write the RFC and include a small repro + unit tests. Ravi will take runtime changes; Tim take SDK patch; Marta will mock console panel. Target: prototype in next sprint.

ravi: One more: change the client docs to recommend `X-Embed-Shape-Hint` for high-throughput clients and show example error parsing and fallback flow.

jia: Great. I'll open the RFC and a minimal PR that returns `400` with the above schema for mixed dims. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
